# Geospatial & Error Resilience Checklist: Phase 4 — Single-Page Application (SPA) & Interactive POI Frontend

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, clarity, and boundary precision for China coordinate transformations (GCJ-02/BD-09), 300ms viewport debouncing, and RFC 7807/9457 error toast mapping prior to implementation.  
**Created**: 2026-10-20  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [frontend-contracts.md](../contracts/frontend-contracts.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. GCJ-02 & BD-09 Coordinate Shifting & Boundary Precision

- [x] CHK001 - Are the geographic coordinate bounds for mainland China explicitly quantified with inclusive mathematical operators ($\le$ and $\ge$)? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-MAP-003]
- [x] CHK002 - Does the specification define coordinate transformation behavior for locations situated precisely on the boundary edges ($73.66^\circ\text{E}$, $135.05^\circ\text{E}$, $18.16^\circ\text{N}$, $53.55^\circ\text{N}$)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 - Are coordinate pass-through requirements explicitly defined for international regions and maritime coordinates lying outside the China bounding box? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-MAP-004]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the convergence threshold for Newton's numerical iteration ($< 0.000001^\circ$) accompanied by a defined maximum iteration ceiling to prevent infinite loops? [Resilience, Spec §REQ-MAP-005, Plan §2]
- [x] CHK005 - Does the specification define the fallback behavior if Newton's numerical iteration fails to achieve convergence within the iteration limit? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements consistent across all modules that coordinates transmitted to or received from backend REST endpoints MUST strictly remain in canonical WGS-84? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-MAP-007, Constitution Invariant 2]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the two-step transformation sequence for Baidu coordinates ($\text{WGS-84} \rightarrow \text{GCJ-02} \rightarrow \text{BD-09}$ and $\text{BD-09} \rightarrow \text{GCJ-02} \rightarrow \text{WGS-84}$) unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-MAP-006, Contracts §3.1]
- [x] CHK008 - Are requirements defined for dynamic marker re-projection when a user switches between standard (WGS-84) and shifted (Amap/Baidu) tile layers without reloading data from the server? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-MAP-002a, Clarifications §Session 2026-10-20]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the interactive pin-drop reverse transformation workflow specified with clear trigger points and coordinate input binding? [Coverage, Spec §REQ-MAP-005, Spec §REQ-UI-023]
- [x] CHK010 - Are numerical test fixtures with known input/output latitude and longitude coordinates documented for validation? [Measurability, Contracts §3.2]

## 2. Viewport Debouncing, Superclustering & Table Synchronization

- [x] CHK011 - Is the 300ms debounce interval explicitly tied to map movement stabilization (`moveend`) rather than continuous motion events (`move`, `drag`)? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-MAP-010, Spec §REQ-MAP-011]
- [x] CHK012 - Does the specification clearly define timer cancellation and reset rules when consecutive pan or zoom gestures occur within the 300ms window? [Resilience, Spec §REQ-MAP-011]
- [x] CHK013 - Are the switching criteria between client-side Supercluster ($< 1,000$ POIs) and server-side PostGIS bounding-box queries ($\ge 1,000$ POIs) quantified with an exact threshold? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-MAP-008, Spec §REQ-MAP-010]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the in-memory GeoJSON data update mechanism specified without triggering page reloads or full layer teardown? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-MAP-009]
- [x] CHK015 - Are race condition handling requirements defined for discarding stale in-flight bounding-box HTTP responses when the user pans to a new viewport before the prior request completes? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK016 - Does the specification define bounding-box query requirements for antimeridian crossings where $\text{minLng} > \text{maxLng}$? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 - When the "Filter table to current map viewport" toggle is active, are table row update timing requirements synchronized with the debounced viewport change? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-MAP-014]
- [x] CHK018 - Does the specification specify empty-state presentation when the active map viewport contains zero matching POIs? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK019 - Are bidirectional selection requirements (table click centering map, map marker click highlighting table row) specified with zoom and scroll behaviors? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-MAP-015, Spec §REQ-MAP-016]
- [x] CHK020 - Can the 60 FPS ($< 16$ms frame budget) client-side clustering performance target be objectively measured during automated benchmarks? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## 3. RFC 7807 / RFC 9457 Error Boundary & Toast Notification Mapping

- [x] CHK021 - Are all standardized RFC 7807 attributes (`type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, `invalid_params`) mapped to specific UI visual elements in the toast banner? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-UI-003, Spec §REQ-UI-004]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the real-time countdown calculation from the `Retry-After` HTTP header explicitly specified for HTTP 429 Too Many Requests responses? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-UI-005]
- [x] CHK023 - Does the specification define how field-specific validation errors in `invalid_params` map to inline form input highlights versus general toast notifications? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-UI-004, Research §2.4]
- [x] CHK024 - Are display duration and auto-dismissal requirements specified based on error status severity (e.g., auto-dismiss for 400 client warnings vs. sticky dismiss for 500 server errors)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK025 - Are stacking, queueing, or deduplication requirements defined when multiple concurrent API failures occur? [Resilience, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 - Does the specification define fallback error mapping when an API endpoint returns non-JSON bodies (e.g., HTML 502/504 Bad Gateway from reverse proxies)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the top-level React Error Boundary specified with actionable recovery controls (e.g., "Reload View", "Return to Safety") for unhandled render exceptions? [Completeness, Plan §4.2]
- [x] CHK028 - Are accessible ARIA notification attributes (`role="alert"`, `aria-live="assertive"`) specified for screen reader announcement of error toasts? [Accessibility, Gap]
- [x] CHK029 - Can the requirement for actionable error guidance versus generic alerts be objectively verified in test suites? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## 4. Cross-Cutting Resilience, Memory & Offline State

- [x] CHK030 - Are memory reclamation requirements specified for revoking ephemeral Blob URLs (`URL.revokeObjectURL`) when photo dialogs close? [Resilience, Spec §REQ-UI-021a]
- [x] CHK031 - Does the specification define behavior when browser private mode disables IndexedDB or exceeds quota limits? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §REQ-UI-027]
- [x] CHK032 - Are offline network indicator requirements defined for retaining cached map tiles and markers without crashing when connectivity drops? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the 7-day TTL eviction requirement for IndexedDB triage jobs tied to an explicit, measurable timestamp calculation? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-UI-027, Data-Model §3.1]
- [x] CHK034 - Are unauthorized access interception requirements for `/admin` specified client-side before any network requests are dispatched? [Security, Spec §REQ-UI-019, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK035 - Are theme switching latency requirements ($< 50$ms) verifiable without page refresh across all map controls and modal dialogs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK036 - Does the specification define graceful degradation when a user declines `navigator.geolocation` permissions during manual POI creation? [Coverage, Spec §REQ-UI-022]
- [x] CHK037 - Are file size ($\le 2$MB) and row count ($\le 2,000$) validation checks required to execute client-side prior to network dispatch? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-UI-024, Constitution Operational Invariant 1]
- [x] CHK038 - Is the W3C `traceparent` telemetry header generation specified across all outbound API requests? [Traceability, Plan §3, Contracts §2]
